##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 21 November 2026 at 11:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Complex area of low pressure and associated frontal zones to the west of Ireland as a ridge of high pressure to the east of Iceland extends south to affect the Irish Sea area.


##Wind##

East or Southeast 6 or 7, gradually decreasing 5 or 6 later tomorrow afternoon and evening.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming moderate later tomorrow.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
